text:
Situation: Ketorolac tromethamine has been on FDA's drug shortage list since 2018-03-23 and remains current as of 2026-10-21. Current inventory across Corvale sites ranges from 11.2 to 23.7 days of supply.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage on 2018-03-23. A Hospira plant (FEI 1925262) on the product label was inspected and classified OAI on 2016-06-08, received a Warning Letter on 2017-02-14, and had a second OAI inspection ending 2018-08-15. Another Hospira plant (FEI 1021343) on the label had OAI inspections in 2010 and 2011 and a Warning Letter in 2010. A Nitto Avecia Pharma Services plant (FEI 3012971227) on the label shows only VAI inspections, the latest ending 2020-01-24.

Our position: Supply is constrained but not exhausted. Multiple alternative manufacturers are not on FDA's shortage list today. We should secure additional supply through approved vendors while maintaining current allocations.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to initiate purchase agreements with Anthea Pharma Private Limited as primary alternative source; requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc., Caplin Steriles Limited, Civica, Inc., and Eugia US LLC as secondary sources; requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list weekly for status changes; no additional approval needed.
4. Inventory team to redistribute existing stock to balance days of supply across sites; requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: Switching to alternative analgesics or changing dosing protocols; clinical decisions remain with treating clinicians and the committee.
